skyrimse.name: Vanilla+
skyrimse.description: Keep the core Skyrim experience with quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and subtle visual upgrades.

skyrimse.name: Survival / Hardcore
skyrimse.description: Hunger, cold, fatigue, and deadly encounters. Transform Skyrim into a harsh survival experience.

skyrimse.name: Combat Overhaul
skyrimse.description: Revamp melee, archery, and magic combat with new animations, dodge mechanics, and enemy AI.

skyrimse.name: Magic / Spellcaster
skyrimse.description: Expand the magic system with hundreds of new spells, enchantments, and magical mechanics.

skyrimse.name: Visual / Graphics
skyrimse.description: Push Skyrim's visuals to the limit with ENB presets, texture packs, weather overhauls, and lighting mods.

skyrimse.name: Immersion / Roleplay
skyrimse.description: Deep roleplaying with NPC overhauls, dialogue expansion, economy changes, and world-building mods.

fallout4.name: Vanilla+
fallout4.description: Improve the base Fallout 4 experience with essential fixes, UI improvements, and balanced tweaks.

fallout4.name: Survival / Hardcore
fallout4.description: Real needs, harder combat, scarce resources, and a truly post-apocalyptic survival experience.

fallout4.name: Settlement Builder
fallout4.description: Supercharge settlement building with expanded objects, snapping, power tools, and city-scale builds.

fallout4.name: Combat / Tactical
fallout4.description: Realistic ballistics, weapon overhauls, new animations, tactical AI, and cover-based combat.

fallout4.name: Visual / Graphics
fallout4.description: Transform the Commonwealth with high-resolution textures, lighting overhauls, weather, and ENB.

fallout4.name: Sim Settlements
fallout4.description: Let settlers build their own homes and shops. Cities grow organically with Sim Settlements framework.
